title: Protocol for Assessing Phagocytosis Activity in Cultured Primary Murine Microglia
author: Layman, Parrott, et al.
materials: Cy™5 AffiniPure Donkey Anti-Rabbit IgG (1:500 dilution)
ProLong™ Gold Antifade Mountant with DAPI

steps.title: Establish breeding cages
steps.instruction: Maintain breeding cages for each genotype containing one male mouse and two female mice to generate pups.

steps.title: Harvest PND2 pups
steps.instruction: Sacrifice male and female pups at postnatal day 2 in a 1:1 sex ratio (or choose gender(s) as required) for each genotype; for PND0‑9 males, sex can be identified by anogenital pigmentation.

steps.title: Pool cortical tissue
steps.instruction: Dissect cortical brain tissue from four pups of the same genotype (WT or Fmr1 KO) and pool them to prepare a mixed‑glial culture.

steps.title: Seed mixed‑glial cultures
steps.instruction: Place 2–6 pooled pup brains (maintaining a 1:1 male:female ratio) into each 75 cm² flask to establish mixed‑glial cultures.

steps.title: Consider alternative developmental stages
steps.instruction: The protocol can also be applied to embryos at ED18/PND0, as well as PND3, PND7/8, and PND10; however, tissue from PND2 provides the most consistent and reliable results.

steps.title: Prepare key resources
steps.instruction: Ensure all reagents listed in the key resources table and all solutions described in the materials and equipment section are prepared before beginning the experiments.
